_comment: Eyebrow weight-role ratchet baseline (design-system consistency CD-02). The count of uppercase-tracked eyebrows across web/src (outside design/), measured by countUppercaseTrackedEyebrows() in consistencyAudit.report.ts: a non-comment line that pairs `uppercase` with a WIDENING tracking utility (tracking-wide/wider/widest or an arbitrary tracking-[…]). The Weight-First rule (web/DESIGN.md §3/§6) bans uppercase-with-tracking; the canonical treatment is the sentence-case `caption` role, vended as the Eyebrow primitive (ui/Eyebrow.tsx). eyebrowWeightRole.test.ts asserts the live count may only be <= this — a NEW tracked eyebrow turns CI red, but the frozen backlog does not block. As surfaces migrate to Eyebrow, RATCHET THIS DOWN (lower the number in the SAME commit). It may only shrink. 131 is the count after FIX-1 migrated the top three offenders — LoopCockpitPage (10), MemoryPanel (9), CodeCockpitPage (8) — from a starting 158. 130 is the count after migrating the canonical Field form-label primitive (ui/forms.tsx) to the sentence-case Eyebrow caption role. 125 is the count after AB-4 extended Eyebrow to semantic h2/h3 and migrated the four heading eyebrows (DesignPanel Preview h2 + palette-group h3, SettingsHome section h2, StoreSideRail rail h2) plus DesignPanel's 'saved' chip span and PersonalityPicker's 'Personality' label span. 124 after the PersonalityPicker span.
